subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] mm/mempolicy: use vm_normal_folio_pmd() in queue_folios_pmd()

2026-09-12.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mm/mempolicy module where mbind() operations on VM_PFNMAP regions would fail due to incorrect handling of huge page mappings. The issue arises when trying to map a VFIO-pci MMIO BAR, which installs a PMD through vmf_insert_pfn_pmd(). The fix involves using the vm_normal_folio_pmd() function instead of pmd_folio(), and skipping on NULL folios while retaining ACTION_CONTINUE handling for huge zero PMDs. This change ensures that mbind(MPOL_MF_STRICT) operations succeed even when mapping VM_PFNMAP regions.

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary:
reviewer questioned the continued use of pmd_folio() and suggested it might be obsolete, recommending a replacement with vm_normal_folio_pmd()

Lorenzo (ARM) noted that since the PMD is a leaf node, setting walk->action to ACTION_CONTINUE or not makes no difference in this specific case, and suggested simplifying the code by removing the check for ACTION_CONTINUE.
